page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.8xlarge is a storage and memory-focused instance from the Local SSDs family, engineered for I/O-intensive workloads. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz across an x86_64 architecture, the system provides 32 vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, 33 MB L3 cache, and instruction set extensions such as AVX-512F and AES. Memory capacity is substantial, providing 256.0 GB of RAM (an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio), alongside 7,679 GB of integrated local SSD storage. Baseline networking bandwidth is configured at 6 Gbps, and the server includes no discrete GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results highlight an architecture oriented toward parallel throughput rather than single-threaded speed. In Geekbench, the instance recorded a weak single-core score of 955.0, paired with an average multi-core score of 8,454.0. Similarly, stress-ng results contrast a lower-tier single-core score of 1,110.08 against an average multi-core output of 23,553.58. Memory operations maintain uncached read throughput of 75.85 GB/sec and write throughput of 46.91 GB/sec. Application testing yielded 23.02 million Redis SET operations per second and 14.08 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, reflecting reliable multi-threaded handling.

The qualitative efficiency of ecs.i2.8xlarge lies in its bundled high-capacity local SSD storage combined with substantial memory density. While single-thread instruction performance and gzip compression speeds are comparatively constrained by the older CPU generation, the massive local disk capacity and dedicated core configuration make it well aligned for distributed databases, caching tiers, search indices, and large-scale analytical processing that do not require modern accelerator hardware.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.8xlarge is a local storage and memory-oriented instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) based on the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, 7,679 GB of high-capacity local SSD storage, and a 6 Gbps baseline network interface, without discrete GPU acceleration. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate mid-tier multi-threaded compute and data handling capacity, achieving 23.02 million Redis SET operations per second, an 8,454.0 Geekbench multi-core score, and an uncached memory read throughput of 75.85 GB/sec. Single-core performance falls in the lower tiers, reflecting the older architecture. Due to the high local storage footprint and significant RAM capacity, ecs.i2.8xlarge is best suited for storage-heavy databases, caching layers, and distributed big data processing tasks.
